name: Karavshin Gorge
full: Karavshin Gorge (the Kara-Suu and Ak-Suu valleys, “Asian Patagonia”)
near: Ozgorush (Uzgurush/Ozguruush) — the starting village of the treks, ~23 km as the crow flies from the catalog point (OSM); there is a guesthouse in the village. From Osh to Uzgurush it is ~360 km, 8–9 h by car (goodway.club).
elev: The valleys are roughly 2500–3000 m (visitkyrgyzstan.org: 2500–5509 m for the district); peaks — Pyramidalny Peak 5509 m (the highest point of the Turkestan Range), Ak-Suu Peak 5355 m, Kotov Peak 4521 m, Usen Peak 4378 m, Asan Peak 4230 m, Slesov Peak 4240 m (central-asia.guide). The highest point of the trek is Ak-Tyubek Pass 4324 m (goodway.club).
short: A gorge in the Turkestan Range in the southwest of Batken Region, with the granite walls of Asan, Usen, Slesov and 4810 peaks — “Asian Patagonia”, one of the world's centers of big-wall climbing; a border zone with a mandatory permit.
desc: Karavshin is a system of valleys of the Kara-Suu and Ak-Suu rivers on the northern slope of the Turkestan Range near the border with Tajikistan (central-asia.guide; visitkyrgyzstan.org). The granite walls of Asan (4230 m), Usen (4378 m), Slesov (4240 m), Pyramidalny (5509 m) and 4810 peaks have made the area famous as “Asian Patagonia”; routes of the highest difficulty category (6B) are climbed here (central-asia.guide; YouTube). There are no roads into the gorge: you get there on foot (about 70 km, central-asia.guide) with pack animals over passes from the village of Uzgurush, or by helicopter. The classic “Asian Patagonia” trek is 106 km in 12 days over the passes Buljuma, Dalgychy (3774 m), Kosh-Moinok (3187 m), Kara-Suu (3702 m) and Ak-Tyubek (4324 m) (goodway.club). The area is in the border zone: a border permit is required for Karavshin and the whole Leilek district (tour.too.kg, 2026). After the armed conflicts of 2021 and 2022 on the border with Tajikistan, the area was hard to reach; on 13.03.2025 a state border treaty was signed and the Kairagach (Leilek district) and Kyzyl-Bel border crossings were opened (Times of Central Asia), and tourist seasons in 2025–2026 are running (Ak-Sai, goodway).
guide: Karavshin is a place for those ready for an expedition: no road, only a week or two on foot over passes up to 4300 m, but at the end — granite walls that climbers compare to Patagonia. The main “stars” are Asan and Usen peaks (by legend, two brothers) and 4810 with 6B routes; even without climbing you will see them from the trail at the confluence of the Kara-Suu and Ak-Suu. Arrange the border-zone permit at least two weeks ahead, or better still go with an operator who will handle the permit, horses and the drop-off from Osh (8–9 hours). The season is short — mid-July to early September, and the most stable window is August. Remember that this is an area by a recently delimited border: keep your documents with you and do not leave the agreed route.
see: The granite walls of Asan (4230 m), Usen (4378 m), Slesov (4240 m), 4810 and Pyramidalny (5509 m) peaks; the Kara-Suu and Ak-Suu valleys with alpine meadows and glaciers; the passes of the “Asian Patagonia” trek (Ak-Tyubek 4324 m, Kara-Suu 3702 m, Dalgychy 3774 m); herds of yaks (central-asia.guide; goodway.club).
skip: You have less than 8–12 days and no experience of multi-day hikes with passes of 3700–4300 m. You are not prepared to arrange a border permit in advance and accept the risks of a border zone. You need signal and infrastructure — there are none in the gorge (except Starlink at the Ak-Sai camps).
diff: Hard: a 106 km trek in 12 days, elevation range 1400–4324 m, 5 passes (goodway.club rates it 3/5 with pack support); the standard loop route is 8 days, 6+ passes, ~8 km of total ascent (epicexpeditions). Mountaineering — up to 6B.
when: Mid-July to early/mid-September; the most stable and driest weather is in August (goodway.club; visitkyrgyzstan.org; epicexpeditions). The Ak-Sai camps operate in July–August. Snow is possible on the high passes even in July.
hours: No schedule; entry into the border zone only with a valid border permit (3000 som, 7 working days to process, apply at least 14 days ahead — tour.too.kg, 2026). Ak-Sai camps — July–August.
daytime: Start early for the passes (before noon there is less risk of bad weather); the walls of Asan and Usen look most striking in morning and evening light (editorial).
how: Osh → Batken (marshrutka (minibus) 320–430 som, ~4.5 h; taxi ~3 h) → Uzgurush (private taxi/4×4). The whole of Osh — Uzgurush is ~360 km, 8–9 h, back ~340 km, 6–7 h (goodway.club). Alternative: a flight Bishkek — Batken (~1.5 h, visitkyrgyzstan.org). From Uzgurush — only on foot/with pack animals over passes (7–12 days by loop; ~70 km to the gorge) or by helicopter.
needcar: Yes: to Uzgurush — a drop-off by car (usually included in the tour); beyond that — on foot with horses/donkeys, or a helicopter.
self: Formally — with a personal border permit (tour.too.kg) and experience of self-sufficient hikes, but in practice a local guide/operator is recommended: almost nobody speaks English, there is no signal, there are no rescue services, and the area is on the border (epicexpeditions; visitkyrgyzstan.org).
roadtype: Paved to Batken; Batken — Uzgurush is a local road (part of the way from Osh passes Uzbek enclaves); from Uzgurush — only trails over passes (goodway.club; epicexpeditions).
traveltime: Osh — Uzgurush 8–9 h (back 6–7 h); Osh — Batken ~4.5 h by marshrutka; the trek to Karavshin takes 2–3 days from Uzgurush, the loop route 8–12 days (goodway.club; epicexpeditions; visitkyrgyzstan.org).
stay:
• Ak-Sai Travel camps (July–August): tent $55/night, with meals $85, single with meals $105; Starlink, generator, shower/toilet tents (ak-sai.com, 2026).
• Guesthouse in Uzgurush: 6 double rooms, contact Sulaiman +996 552 717 178 (WhatsApp) (epicexpeditions, 2026).
• Guesthouses in Batken — $15–25/night (visitkyrgyzstan.org).
• Otherwise — your own tents, and all equipment and food you bring yourself.
net: There is no mobile signal in the gorge (visitkyrgyzstan.org); there is signal at the guesthouse in Uzgurush (goodway.club); at the Ak-Sai camps — Starlink (ak-sai.com).
entry: There is no entrance fee, but a border permit is mandatory: 3000 som per person, 7 working days to process (tour.too.kg, 2026; one permit covers all border zones). Through operators/CBT — €20–30 (epicexpeditions) or included in the tour price.
transfer: Marshrutka Osh — Batken 320–430 som; taxi Osh — Batken $30–40; the Osh — Uzgurush drop-off is included in the goodway tour ($630 for 12 days); a porter at the Ak-Sai camps — $55; pack animals — $10–15/day (2025–2026 sources, some without a year).
bring: Border permit and passport; full equipment for a multi-day hike (tent, sleeping bag rated to −5 °C, stove, crampons/ice axe for Ak-Tyubek depending on conditions); a first-aid kit; food for the whole route; cash (there are no ATMs in Uzgurush — not confirmed); a satellite communicator.
warn: Border zone on the border with Tajikistan: a border permit is mandatory (3000 som, 7 working days, tour.too.kg 2026). The area suffered in the conflicts of 2021 and 2022; the border treaty was signed on 13.03.2025, but the US recommends “increased caution” in the 30 km zone and Australia says to “reconsider the need to travel”; a brief closure of the crossing near Leilek was reported in early 2026, as well as unexploded ordnance after 2022 (epicexpeditions, 2026). There is no signal and no rescue service; altitude up to 4300 m; snow on the passes is possible in summer.
food: Home cooking at the guesthouse in Uzgurush; Batken apricots (dried apricots, uryuk); at the Ak-Sai camps — three meals a day (ak-sai.com).
reviews: The Google Maps pin is not matched, no rating (07.10.2026). Reports from hikers and climbers (goodway, epicexpeditions, Mountain Project) unanimously note the outstanding granite walls and solitude; minuses — complicated logistics, the permit, no signal and no infrastructure.
p.sum: Karavshin is a multi-day trek / mountaineering expedition: first a border permit for Leilek District (tour.too.kg, 3000 som, 5–7 working days; with Ak-Sai it is $40 and ~1 month), then Osh/Batken → the village of Uzgurush (Ozgorush) by car (Osh — Uzgurush ~300–360 km, 7–9 h), then on foot with pack horses/donkeys: 18 km (1 day) to the base camp or 7–11 days around the “Asian Patagonia” loop. The easiest is a group tour (Visit Alay 11 days $500, goodway 12 days $630) or the Ak-Sai camps ($55–105/night).

p.season: July — September (Ak-Sai camps — July — August); snow on the passes is possible all summer; in October — snow. Apricots in Batken — June — July.
p.budget.economy: ~$300–500 for 7–10 days: permit 3000 som, marshrutka to Batken 500 som, a share of the transfer to Uzgurush, a donkey/horse $15–30/day per group, your own food and equipment; or a Visit Alay tour for $500 all in.
p.budget.comfort: $800–1600: a Kyrgyz Tourism tour or the Ak-Sai camps ($85–105/night with meals) + an Osh — Uzgurush transfer $230–280 per car.
p.permits: A border permit for Leilek District is mandatory: tour.too.kg, 3000 som, 5–7 working days (office at 105/3 Isanov St, Bishkek), one permit for all border zones; via Ak-Sai — $40, about 1 month, you need a copy of your passport and insurance from $20,000. It is checked at border posts on the road to Uzgurush / in the gorge. Tours usually include the permit.
p.access: Only for experienced trekkers/mountaineers. Not accessible for children, older people or wheelchair users. With a dog — not advisable (border zone, shepherd dogs).
